tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Call first when a traveller names a city or country. Every city LocalSpot Trip plans (257 cities, 62 countries), with the trip lengths it has ready-made plans for. Optional country filter (e.g. japan, france, usa).

tools.name: trip_plan
tools.description: Use when the traveller wants an itinerary or a day-by-day plan for a city. A ready plan: neighbourhoods per day, timed sights and meals (places locals eat), travel minutes, plus links to open and edit it in the planner, compare where to stay, and see where locals eat. Give the traveller the open_in_

tools.name: request_city
tools.description: Ask LocalSpot Trip to add a city it does not plan yet (when list_destinations does not have it). Counts the request; the most requested cities are built first. Tell the traveller it is not covered yet and that the request was passed on. No personal data.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Korea only: Korean cities and their neighbourhoods covered by local.korea.

tools.name: find_places
tools.description: Korea only: restaurants, cafés or bars in a Korean city, best first by local card payments. Optional: neighbourhood, food keyword, open at a given day and time. Up to 8 results.

tools.name: place_info
tools.description: Korea only: hours, break time, closing days, rush hour, why it is picked, and links for one place by name (Korean or English).

tools.name: open_nearby
tools.description: Korea only: closed or a long line? Places open at a given time within a short walk (about 900 m) of a place or a point.

tools.name: sights
tools.description: Korea only: sights in a Korean city (optionally one neighbourhood): best time of day, typical visit minutes, closing day, a practical tip.

tools.name: plan_link
tools.description: Korea only: a link that opens the local.korea planner with these places and sights loaded, split into days by neighbourhood with hours checked. Give it to the traveller.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_destinations" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
